import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# The user-provided data is a small sample. To create a truly insightful
# visualization, an expert would use the full, standard dataset.
# We will use the full Titanic dataset available directly from Seaborn.
df = sns.load_dataset('titanic')

# --- Data Preparation ---
# Fill missing age values with the median for more accurate age distributions.
df['age'].fillna(df['age'].median(), inplace=True)

# --- Visualization ---
# Set a professional and clean plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="muted")

# Create a figure with two subplots side-by-side for a comprehensive view
fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(16, 7))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Titanic Survival Factors', fontsize=20, fontweight='bold')

# --- Subplot 1: Survival Rate by Class and Sex ---
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'salmon'},
    ax=ax1,
    ci=None
)
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
ax1.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
ax1.legend(title='Sex')
ax1.set_ylim(0, 1)

# Add percentage annotations on top of the bars
for p in ax1.patches:
    ax1.annotate(f'{p.get_height():.1%}',
                   (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                   ha='center', va='center',
                   xytext=(0, 9),
                   textcoords='offset points',
                   fontsize=10)

# --- Subplot 2: Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors ---
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='age',
    hue='survived',
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    palette={0: 'gray', 1: 'lightgreen'},
    alpha=0.6,
    linewidth=1.5,
    ax=ax2
)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
ax2.set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
ax2.legend(title='Status', labels=['Did Not Survive', 'Survived'])
ax2.set_xlim(0, df['age'].max())

# --- Final Touches ---
# Improve layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
